title: Disable Touchscreen
name: disable-touchscreen
description: Disable touch input on laptops/tablets with a touchscreen, so accidental taps don't register.
deepDescription: Disables the touchscreen's HID input collection at the device level, so finger touches stop registering entirely. On machines with a separate pen/stylus (e.g. Wacom-equipped ThinkPads), the stylus is a different device and is not affected. Only applies to machines that actually have a touchscreen; on any other machine this tweak does nothing. It is fully reversible.
modal: This disables touchscreen (finger touch) input. If your device has a separate stylus/pen, it keeps working normally. Reversible at any time.
